name: ob1-extensions-tests

scripts.sync-auth: for d in _shared ../recipes/_shared ../recipes/editorial-policy/_shared ../integrations/_shared ../integrations/consolidation-workers/_shared; do cp ../server-portable/auth.ts "$d/auth.ts"; done
scripts.sync-sse: for d in _shared ../recipes/_shared ../integrations/_shared; do cp ../server-portable/sse.ts "$d/sse.ts"; done

comment: Test-only (SMD-1252, FORK.md change 64): test-auth.ts imports the seven extension servers, and since change 67 (SMD-1455) the vendored recipes' and integrations' servers, as deployed; test-writes.ts (change 69, SMD-1228; change 71, SMD-1524) drives the vendored writers of a thought's content or vector against a real Postgres; test-tools.ts (change 77, SMD-1588; SMD-1798) drives every tool of the eight MCP servers with a schema of their own — seven extensions and the ob-graph recipe — against those schemas. hono and zod are one set across the tree's three installs; the MCP packages split during the SDK v2 migration — server-portable is on the v2 scoped @modelcontextprotocol/core + @modelcontextprotocol/server (SMD-2278), while this directory and integrations/kubernetes-deployment stay on the v1 @modelcontextprotocol/sdk + @hono/mcp until SMD-2279 / SMD-2281 (SMD-1800 removed the deno.json import maps that used to mirror them) — so the test exercises the libraries the servers run on; test-auth.ts holds each install to its stack and fails on drift. Bump the shared packages across all three in the same commit. recipes/node_modules and integrations/node_modules are committed links to this directory's node_modules, so a recipe or integration run from a checkout resolves this install too (SMD-1991). No types package: bun runs the test untyped, and nothing type-checks this directory. `bun run sync-auth` rewrites every _shared/auth.ts from server-portable/auth.ts; the test names the five and fails if one differs. `bun run sync-sse` does the same for the three _shared/sse.ts beside the MCP servers, from server-portable/sse.ts (SMD-2001).
